facts.business: OBCL Limited provides Full Truck Load (FTL) transportation and third-party logistics services across India, operating through a fleet of owned and hired vehicles, and also engages in trading of commodities such as coal, sand, iron, and steel.

auditor.name: Not stated in excerpts
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Emphasis of Matter regarding confirmation of certain balances and identification of MSME creditors; opinion not modified.

key_risks: Goods transportation industry is unorganized, competitive and highly fragmented
Dependence on hired vehicles (around 18,000) for timely service delivery
Balance confirmation from certain parties pending
Vendor classification process for MSME identification being strengthened
